Chatham Island population

Chatham Island
song dialect
CommunicationMating

New Zealand chaffinches have songs with elaborate end phrases; these are not present in the Chatham offshoot population which is a small population with a reduced number of phrases (Baker & Jenkins 1987)

Recorded from 1981 to 1985
Vertical: UnknownHorizontal: UnknownOblique: Possible
Evidence and details

Description: New Zealand chaffinches have songs with elaborate end phrases; these are not present in the Chatham offshoot population which is a small population with a reduced number of phrases (Baker & Jenkins 1987)

Vertical: suspected unknown

Horizontal: suspected unknown

Oblique: "The major finding of the study is that the syllable pool in the isolated Chatham population is depauperate relative to those in the New Zealand population. The Chatham Island songs, however, have not diverged greatly because 18 of the 20 Chatham syllable types are also present in New Zealand. It is concluded that the Chatham Islands were colonized by a small number of founders who had already learnt their syllables and songs from adult conspecifics in New Zealand." (Baker 1987)

Domains: communication; mating
